executive_summary: Maven test compilation failed with 100 errors across 3 test classes. Primary issues: (1) Type mismatches between Priority/TaskPriority enums and long/UUID/String types, (2) Method signature incompatibilities where service methods expect different parameter counts/types than provided, (3) Missing methods in DTOs and exception handlers. Root cause: Test code not updated after refactoring domain model to use UUID identifiers and renaming Priority enum to TaskPriority.

errors.message: Multiple type incompatibility errors: Priority cannot be converted to TaskPriority (15 occurrences)
errors.root_cause: Test code uses Priority enum but domain model was refactored to use TaskPriority enum. Tests not updated after enum rename.
errors.fix_recommendation: Replace all occurrences of 'Priority' with 'TaskPriority' in TaskControllerTest.java. Update import statement from 'com.myproject.models.dtos.Priority' to 'com.myproject.models.dtos.TaskPriority'.

errors.message: Type conversion errors: long cannot be converted to UUID (12 occurrences) and long cannot be converted to String (9 occurrences)
errors.root_cause: Domain model refactored to use UUID for task IDs and String for user IDs, but test code still uses primitive long values.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update test data initialization: (1) Replace long task IDs with UUID.randomUUID() or UUID.fromString() calls, (2) Replace long user IDs with String values like "user-123", (3) Update all method calls passing IDs to use correct types.

errors.message: Method signature mismatch: createTask, getUserTasks, getTaskById, updateTask, deleteTask, bulkCreateTasks methods called with wrong parameter counts
errors.root_cause: Service interface methods refactored to require userId/username as first parameter, but test mocks don't include this parameter.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all service method mock calls to include userId/username as first parameter. Example: when(taskService.createTask(request)) should become when(taskService.createTask("user-123", request)).

errors.message: Constructor errors: TaskCreateRequest, TaskResponse, TaskUpdateRequest, TaskCountResponse, BulkTaskResponse constructors cannot be applied
errors.root_cause: DTO classes refactored to use builder pattern or no-args constructors with setters, but tests use all-args constructors.
errors.fix_recommendation: Replace constructor calls with builder pattern or create objects using no-args constructor and setters. Example: new TaskCreateRequest(...) should become TaskCreateRequest.builder().title(...).description(...).build().

errors.root_cause: GlobalExceptionHandler method handleValidationErrors was renamed or removed during refactoring.
errors.fix_recommendation: Check GlobalExceptionHandler class for the correct method name handling MethodArgumentNotValidException. Update test to call the correct method name, likely handleMethodArgumentNotValid().

errors.message: Cannot find symbol: method getCode() in ErrorResponse (8 occurrences)
errors.root_cause: ErrorResponse DTO no longer has getCode() method, likely replaced with getStatus() or getErrorCode().
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all errorResponse.getCode() calls to use the correct getter method. Check ErrorResponse class definition and replace with errorResponse.getStatus() or errorResponse.getErrorCode().

errors.message: Type incompatibility: Priority cannot be converted to TaskPriority (2 occurrences), long cannot be converted to String/UUID (multiple)
errors.root_cause: Same enum rename and ID type changes as TaskControllerTest, affecting data store tests.
errors.fix_recommendation: Apply same fixes as TaskControllerTest: (1) Replace Priority with TaskPriority, (2) Use UUID for task IDs, (3) Use String for user IDs.

errors.message: Cannot find symbol: method findAll() and existsById() in InMemoryTaskDataStore
errors.root_cause: InMemoryTaskDataStore interface changed - findAll() and existsById() methods removed or renamed.
errors.fix_recommendation: Check InMemoryTaskDataStore interface for available query methods. Replace findAll() with appropriate method like findByUserId() with pagination. Replace existsById() with findById() and check for Optional.isPresent().

summary: 8 grouped compilation error categories found affecting 100 individual compilation failures
